scope: IBSR18 potential REAL brain-support/component-learning source; metadata only. Not a patient substitute, planner admission, source download release, or training declaration.

local_audit_first.existing_context: NFBS seed-library augmentation ancestry unresolved; LPBA40 requires a new license agreement. No previously completed IBSR qualification was located.

legal_access.readme_access: Current unauthenticated GET redirects to NITRC login at the resource administrator’s request; README contents were not obtained.
legal_access.download_archive_access: Published routes identified, but no archive request was made; access behind login and any further terms were not tested.
legal_access.rights_interpretation: The displayed non-commercial scope does not authorize company/commercial model use. No exception, redistribution/model-rights interpretation, or agreement acceptance is inferred.

release_inventory.hash_limit: Saved HTML hashes bind observed metadata pages only. No dataset byte hash or exact archive size was measured; no dataset checksum appears in the inspected file rows.

real_acquisition_and_annotation.supported: Official project describes MR images with manually guided expert segmentations; official release identifies eighteen 1.5 mm scans with segmentations.
real_acquisition_and_annotation.original_participant_identity: Eighteen is the advertised source-person count. ANALYZE, parcellation, and stripped NIfTI releases are representations/labels of that cohort, not independent subjects.
real_acquisition_and_annotation.ibsr20_overlap: IBSR20 is listed as a separate 20-normal-subject package. No participant alias/crosswalk or explicit overlap exclusion was available in the inspected sources;18+20 must not be claimed as 38 independent people.
real_acquisition_and_annotation.overlap_with_other_component_sources: No person-level crosswalk to NFBS, LPBA40, Lausanne or other derivatives was established; shared institutional authorship or different dataset name is insufficient.
real_acquisition_and_annotation.ancestry_limit: Manually guided does not identify an initializer. It establishes neither absence nor presence of prohibited synthetic/augmented training ancestors; later manual correction cannot remove an actual prohibited ancestor.
real_acquisition_and_annotation.classical_preprocessing_distinction: Deterministic/nonlearned bias correction or coordinate conversion is conceptually distinct from learned weights trained on fabricated data. The accessible pages do not establish the release-specific executed preprocessing/initialization, so neither is asserted here.

image_and_label_contract.advertised_spacing: 1.5mm scans; full 3-axis spacing and orientation not verified
image_and_label_contract.coverage_limit: A skull-stripped image is not by itself a validated brain-support mask. Label codes, tissue/support inclusion and retained extracranial context require official documentation and later separately permitted binary QC.
image_and_label_contract.clinical_scope: No glioma/operative-field support, functional evidence, or review of any uploaded patient is established.

one_concrete_next_step.action: Keep IBSR out of current training. If a separate non-commercial component study is intended, obtain only the official 20 KB IBSR18 README through separately authorized existing NITRC access, then resolve exact initialization/annotation ancestry and participant aliases before proposing any payload acquisition.
one_concrete_next_step.blocker_for_current_company_scope: Non-commercial-only published terms; commercial rights not established.
one_concrete_next_step.not_performed: No login, account creation, contact, license acceptance or payload acquisition.
